title: Metaplasm
summary: MET'APLASM, noun [Gr. transformation; over, and to form.] In grammar, a transmutation or change made in a word by transposing or retrenching a syllable or letter.

inlines.v: MET'APLASM, noun [Gr. transformation; over, and to form.] In grammar, a transmutation or change made in a word by transposing or retrenching a syllable or letter.
